sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed by WIP.1: a SOLO entity (not joined with anyone else) whose own MusicBrainz-rendered `<bdi>` also carries a sibling `.comment` span — e.g. "David Bowie (English singer‐songwriter)" appearing alone in the Artist column, not just in the "Queen & David Bowie" joined credit — had its name computed as the WHOLE bdi text (name + comment combined) instead of just its own name. This broke the "» name: David Bowie" row filter for every solo occurrence (comparing the clean selected value against a comment-polluted name never matched), and kept those rows' name/comment from merging into the same "Entity info - Artist name"/"Entity info - Comment" entries the joined row already offered. `_findCellEntityRefs()` now always scopes an entity's `name`/`nameNode` to its own anchor alone whenever the governing `<bdi>` is an ancestor of it — never the whole bdi — regardless of whether that bdi is shared with another joined entity.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: A joined artist credit (e.g. "Queen & David Bowie") silently dropped any entity whose own link MusicBrainz wraps in `<span class="mp">` — its native marker for an entity with open/pending edits — from the "Entity info - Artist name"/"Entity info - Comment" sections of the 📊 unique-values dropdown. `_findCellEntityRefs()` only recognized a credited name as a direct child of its shared `<bdi>` or containing its own nested `<bdi>`; it now resolves the governing `<bdi>` via an ancestor walk instead, so any incidental wrapper is transparent to it.

`_findCellEntityCommentParts()` also mis-attributed comments when a cell has more than one independently-commented entity sharing a `<bdi>` with no `<li>` boundary between them (the same "Queen & David Bowie" shape) — every entity after the first silently inherited the FIRST entity's own comment instead of its own. It now resolves each entity's own adjacent `.comment` span instead of taking the first match in the whole cell.
